city.notes: Covers the Delhi Metro network (Phases I–III incl. operational Phase III/IV extensions), the Airport Express line, the Gurugram Rapid Metro, and the NMRC Aqua Line. Under-construction corridors are not included.

coordinates.source: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API (ODbL). Fetched once at build time; not used at runtime.

dmrc.label: DMRC distance slabs
dmrc.note: Standard (token) fares. Smart-card journeys are ~10% cheaper, and off-peak/Sunday fares are lower.

airportExpress.label: Airport Express (Orange Line) fares
airportExpress.note: The Airport Express has its own fare table, separate from the rest of the DMRC network.

nmrcAqua.label: NMRC Aqua Line fares
nmrcAqua.note: Noida Metro Rail Corporation operates the Aqua Line with its own fare table.

rapidMetro.label: Gurugram Rapid Metro fares
rapidMetro.note: Rapid Metro Gurugram operates a short flat-ish fare table.

edges.note: Loop section — trains run one-way around the loop.
Blue Line ↔ Aqua Line via the ~300 m foot overbridge. Separate ticketing — you must exit and re-enter.
Airport Express ↔ Pink Line via the Dhaula Kuan skywalk. Requires exiting and re-entering.

transfers.note: Blue Line ↔ Aqua Line via the ~300 m foot overbridge. Separate ticketing — you must exit and re-enter.
Airport Express ↔ Pink Line via the Dhaula Kuan skywalk. Requires exiting and re-entering.

terminals.note: Direct Airport Express station inside Terminal 3.
No dedicated station. Alight at IGI Airport (Terminal 3) and use the free inter-terminal shuttle to T2 (~5 min).
Served directly by the Magenta Line station Terminal 1-IGI Airport.

airports.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport
airports.note: Mumbai Metro is not included in this data build. No route can be planned.

airports.name: Chennai International Airport
airports.note: Chennai Metro is not included in this data build. No route can be planned.

terminals.note: Nearest metro railhead. Hindon Airport itself is ~6 km away by road — the metro does not reach the terminal.
